liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- Played for the first time since October 31, 2022, after 177 shows [1]
- Contained quotes and teases for Hypertension and Tool's Forty Six & 2 [1]

## The recordings

- **kglw2025-12-13.SBD** (recommended): soundboard; 0 songs; 123 min [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **kglw2025-12-13.SBD**: taped by Sam Joseph, Joseph Santarpia; source: SBD [1]. Also: Gaspard de Meulemeester played drums for the Altered Beast I section [1]
